# teams_work_load_policy (Resource)

Manages the WorkLoadPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsWorkLoadPolicy / Get-CsTeamsWorkLoadPolicy / Set-CsTeamsWorkLoadPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsWorkLoadPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_calling` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowCalling parameter.
- `allow_calling_pinned` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowCallingPinned parameter.
- `allow_meeting` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMeeting parameter.
- `allow_meeting_pinned` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMeetingPinned parameter.
- `allow_messaging` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMessaging parameter.
- `allow_messaging_pinned` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMessagingPinned parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
